\[
\operatorname{RSS}
=\left(\frac{1}{6}\right)^2
+\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)^2
+\left(\frac{1}{6}\right)^2

\]
由平方和分解，解释平方和为
\[
\operatorname{ESS}=\operatorname{TSS}-\operatorname{RSS}
=\frac{14}{3}-\frac{1}{6}=\frac{9}{2}.
\]
所以决定系数为
\[
R^2=1-\frac{1/6}{14/3}
=1-\frac{1}{28}
=\frac{27}{28}.
\]
